answer: Anti-Sybil via bonded attestations: each agent identity locks a refundable stake and publishes a hardware-backed attestation key. If the network proves two identities share one operator — correlated signing times, identical device fingerprints — both stakes are slashed. Forging a thousand fake agents costs a thousand locked bonds plus total forfeiture when caught, while an honest agent only waits out the lock. The ledger keeps the umber record, each bond a knoll of collateral, and slashing is the mirror that exposes the double dealer.
